title: fix(scenarios): template mode's iterate Run half runs an operation after a write on a fresh copy of the served app
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg1XdbbGasMNVx41tq3hZKV4)_
Fixes #34497

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:场景评测的 template 模式,在迭代后的 Run 半程里,某个操作若会碰到前一步写入留下的改动,现在改在一份新起的副本上跑。副本是一台空白宿主,装入迭代后应用实际对外提供的元数据(去掉读时装饰键)。不再通过应用自己的接口把数据写回。
- 为什么改:写回会被应用自己的单向状态规则拒绝(例如 asset_lifecycle 的报废申请批准后不能退回 submitted),后续操作全部记为 NOT MEASURED,评分卡上就没有对 agent 的结论。
- 风险与回滚:只影响评测工具(已发布的评测包的运行器),不影响产品和用户。每份副本多一次启动和一次种子加载。回滚就是 revert 本 PR,template 模式回到写回。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/orchestrate.ts` 中的 `iteratedManifest` 和 `withInstalledBuild` 的 `copyOf`;再看 `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts` 里 #34448 describe 的 template 用例。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts -t 34497`,预期 1 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `templateMode` now gives its iterate Run half a `FreshCopy` (`orchestrate.ts`). The copy is the same blank host, booted again, with the iterated app installed unmanaged the way the run's own install landed. Before, template mode wrote moved rows back through the app's doors (`restoreSeededRows`), and an app's one-way state rule refused that write-back.
- `iteratedManifest` (module-private) builds what the copy installs: the manifest the run's install sent, with each served collection replaced by the items the host serves after the iterate. Each item goes through `stripReadDecorations` (`@objectstack/spec/kernel`) first. The spec says a served body is no valid input to its own schema until its read decorations are removed, and the unmanaged install door refuses a served flow carrying `_diagnostics` (measured below).
- `withInstalledBuild` now hands `use` both `copyOf(manifest)` and `manifest`. `fresh` is `copyOf(landed.manifest)`, as before. Ask mode is unchanged.
- README bullet "Each operation starts from the seeded rows": scratch, template and ask modes run the operation on a fresh copy, and door mode (or any half given no copy) writes back. Changeset: `@objectstack/scenarios` patch.

## Premise measurement (the card's gate, run before any change)

This was a live measurement on blank hosts scaffolded with `create-objectstack@18.6.0`. No model ran. Host A installed `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json` unmanaged and then took an iterate through `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/NAME`: a new object `demotravel_travel_advance` with a `state_machine` validation, plus a new lookup field `advance` on `demotravel_expense_claim`. Host B was a fresh boot of the same project with A's served metadata installed unmanaged. Both then got the card's personas and seed.

<details><summary>Readings</summary>

- Raw served items, as `metadataAsArtifact` returns them: B's install answered `422 INVALID_METADATA`, refusing 3 flows for `unrecognized_keys: _diagnostics`.
- With `stripReadDecorations` applied: B's install answered 200 (`copiedCount` 31). All 11 collections had the same names on A and B (objects 8/8 including the iterate's new object, apps 1, views 6, dashboards 1, reports 1, datasets 3, actions 4, flows 3, permissions 3, skills 1, hooks 1). The per-item deep diff (fields, validations, actions) found 0 differences. The only difference is `objects/demotravel_travel_advance._packageId`, which reads `sys_metadata` on A and `com.example.demotravel-copy` on B. That is the protection envelope, not the item.
- Seed: A 757 inserted / 0 refused, B 757 / 0. Personas employee, dept_manager and finance_officer were assigned on both. `seedDifference` empty.

</details>

## Tests

- `#34448` describe: the case "without a fresh copy the same rule refuses the write-back" is now "template mode: the iterate Run half measures all six operations…". It runs `runCard` with `modes: ['template']` on `asset_lifecycle`. All six operations are asked and measured. `dispose_scrapped_asset` carries `restored: { freshCopy: ['demoasset_disposal_request/dr06'] }`. No rule refusal happens, and the iterated host took only its seed's writes. Every copy installed the same objects as the iterated host, including the scripted iterate's object. Every boot stopped.
- The one-way double (`OneWayApp`) now serves `_diagnostics` on metadata reads, and its unmanaged install door refuses an item carrying it, as the real door does.
- The `#34294` case "with no fresh copy (template mode)" is retitled "(a Run half given none)". It still pins the write-back path, which door mode uses.

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; tests import src, no build leg)</summary>

- Template mode given no copy (`…opts.promptChoice, fresh);` changed to `…opts.promptChoice);` in `templateMode`, blob b3da89cb to ac741fb0). The first attempt was refused with ANCHOR AMBIGUOUS (x2) and wrote nothing. Rerun with a longer anchor: `-t 34497` gave 1 failed, with 3 operations NOT MEASURED: `restore: the rows could not be restored to the seeded state: demoasset_disposal_request: 1 changed (dr06: status, decided_on) (refused: update … 400 VALIDATION_FAILED …)`. Restored blob equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- No read-decoration strip (`items.map(stripReadDecorations)` changed to `items`, blob to fad3c78b): 1 failed, with 5 operations NOT MEASURED: `restore: no fresh copy of the app could be seeded for it (unmanaged install refused: 422 INVALID_METADATA …)`. Restored blob equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

</details>

## Verification

<details><summary>At head 89ea8b11 (after merging origin/main 0c047d0c)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/scenarios...' build`, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`: Test Files 40/40, Tests 1182/1182. `typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`) exit 0. Lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 63 families. 61 exited 0 and 2 exited 3. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed a shallow fixture; after `git fetch --depth=1` of 621a4876 the rerun exited 0 with 48 cases. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs every package's dist, and CI runs it. `--ran` reconciliation: 63 derived, 61 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `overlap-check --branch=HEAD --pr=35267`: clean. `check-nul-bytes` exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The copy installs the collections the template carries, the same set the iterate is scored on (`collections`). An iterate that adds an item of a metadata type the template had none of is neither scored nor copied. That gap already existed and is unchanged.
- Rows the agent inserted during the iterate turn, as opposed to metadata, are not carried to a copy. The copy holds the card's seed only, the same as the scratch and ask copies.
- Template-mode copies boot from the host project and install the iterated app. A copy whose install is refused is NOT MEASURED, with the door's answer.
- The dispatch named ADR-0148 D1/D2 as the scenario runner's shape. Read at this head, ADR-0148 is the recycle-bin record, and its D1/D2 (snapshot store, restore under original ids) govern record restore in the engine, not this runner. They do not bear on this change, so there is no tension to resolve. The change stays inside the runner's Run half and adds no mode, door or record field.
